title: CSV In, Dicts Out
prompt: Implement parse_csv(text) receiving raw CSV text (with a header row) and returning a list of dicts. Then implement to_csv_text(rows, fieldnames) doing the reverse. Use csv module round-trip via io.StringIO.

tests.name: writes back the same shape
tests.code:
rows = [{'name': 'An', 'age': '30'}]
out = to_csv_text(rows, ['name', 'age'])
assert 'name,age' in out and 'An,30' in out

tests.name: round-trip identity
tests.hint: A faithful round-trip reproduces the original text.
